title: SECURITY TEAMS MANAGEMENT
overview: This practical course equips security supervisors and managers to lead, deploy, coordinate, and improve physical security teams across facilities, events, and operational sites. Participants develop the leadership, risk-based planning, workforce management, communication, incident command, and performance-monitoring skills needed to deliver professional, lawful, and reliable security operations. Emphasis is placed on clear procedures, proportional responses, staff welfare, coordination with stakeholders, and continuous improvement.
audience: Security supervisors, shift leaders, site security managers, control room supervisors, facilities and operations managers with security responsibilities, contract security coordinators, and experienced security officers preparing for leadership roles.
methodology: Facilitated discussions, realistic site-security case studies, team deployment exercises, shift briefing simulations, incident tabletop scenarios, communication drills, supervisor role plays, performance dashboard workshops, and a practical security team improvement plan.
competencies: Operational deployment, rostering, and resource allocation
Threat and vulnerability awareness and risk-based prioritization
Standard operating procedures and compliance oversight
Communication, conflict management, and staff coaching
Quality assurance, performance measurement, and continuous improvement
objectives: Define the responsibilities, authority, and ethical obligations of a security team leader.
Translate site risks and service requirements into practical post orders and staffing plans.
Organize shifts, patrols, access control, and control-room coverage effectively.
Deliver concise briefings, maintain accurate records, and coordinate with stakeholders.
Direct an appropriate initial response to incidents while protecting life and preserving evidence.
Coach security personnel, manage performance concerns, and reinforce professional conduct.
Monitor operational KPIs, conduct reviews, and implement measurable improvements.
